books.title: A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: The sixth book in the "Court of Thorns and Roses" series. Former alliances must be restored to fight the threat of Koschei the Deathless.
books.expected_description_zh: 《荆棘与玫瑰之庭》系列第六部。为了对抗不死者科谢伊的威胁，昔日盟友必须重建联盟。

books.title: THE HOLLOW
books.author: Michael Connelly
books.description: The 21st book in the Harry Bosch series. Bosch investigates the facility where he was a ward of the state in his youth.
books.expected_description_zh: 哈里·博斯系列第21部。博斯调查了他少年时受国家监护、被安置的机构。

books.title: PUBLIC ACCESS AFTERWORLD
books.author: Jane Schoenbrun
books.description: Surreal broadcasts from a pirate TV network affect outcasts across several decades.
books.expected_description_zh: 一家地下电视网播出的超现实节目，影响了跨越数十年的边缘人群。

books.title: THE KEEPER
books.author: Ana Huang
books.description: The third book in the Gods of the Game series. Carina Vu becomes a nanny to the daughter of a goalkeeper who is also a single dad.
books.expected_description_zh: 《球场之神》系列第三部。卡丽娜·武成为一名守门员女儿的保姆；这位守门员也是一名单亲父亲。

books.title: CHRISTMAS STAYCATION
books.author: Meghan Quinn
books.description: The third book in the "How My Neighbor Stole Christmas" series. Taran is caught between brothers this holiday season.
books.expected_description_zh: 《邻居如何偷走圣诞节》系列第三部。这个假日季，塔兰陷入一对兄弟之间的纠葛。

books.title: A COURT OF MIST AND FURY
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: The second book in the "Court of Thorns and Roses" series. Feyre gains the powers of the High Fae and a greater evil emerges.
books.expected_description_zh: 《荆棘与玫瑰之庭》系列第二部。费耶获得高等仙灵的力量，更大的邪恶随之出现。

books.title: HOUSE OF EARTH AND BLOOD
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: Passion arises between Bryce Quinlan and Hunt Athalar as they seek to avenge the deaths of Bryce’s friends.
books.expected_description_zh: 布莱丝·昆兰与亨特·阿萨拉尔为给布莱丝死去的朋友复仇而携手，彼此之间萌生爱意。

books.title: A COURT OF SILVER FLAMES
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: The fifth book in the "Court of Thorns and Roses" series. Nesta Archeron is forced into close quarters with a warrior named Cassian.
books.expected_description_zh: 《荆棘与玫瑰之庭》系列第五部。内丝塔·阿切伦被迫与名叫卡西安的战士近距离相处。

books.title: HEATED RIVALRY
books.author: Rachel Reid
books.description: The second book in the Game Changers series. Rival captains of two hockey teams try to keep their relationship out of the spotlight; the basis of the TV series.
books.expected_description_zh: 《游戏改变者》系列第二部。两支冰球队的对手队长试图让他们的关系远离公众视线；本书是相关电视剧的原作。

books.title: A COURT OF WINGS AND RUIN
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: The third book in the "Court of Thorns and Roses" series. As war approaches, Feyre endeavors to take charge of her magical and political powers.
books.expected_description_zh: 《荆棘与玫瑰之庭》系列第三部。战事将近，费耶努力掌控自己的魔法力量与政治权力。

books.title: AND I WILL TELL YOU MINE
books.author: Sophia Bush
books.description: The actress, activist and host of the "Work in Progress With Sophia Bush" podcast shares stories from her life and career.
books.expected_title_zh: 我也会告诉你我的故事
books.expected_description_zh: 演员、活动人士兼播客“Work in Progress With Sophia Bush”主持人讲述自己生活和职业生涯中的故事。

books.title: PRINCES AND THIEVES
books.author: Matthew Cole
books.description: An account of the financial and political alliances between Jared Kushner, Erik Prince, Mohammed bin Zayed and Mohammed bin Salman.
books.expected_description_zh: 讲述贾里德·库什纳、埃里克·普林斯、穆罕默德·本·扎耶德和穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼之间的金融与政治联盟。

books.title: ABANDONING A CAT
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: Murakami reflects on his relationship with his father, from whom he had been estranged for 20 years; translated by Philip Gabriel.
books.expected_description_zh: 村上春树回顾自己与父亲的关系；两人曾疏远20年。英文译者为菲利普·加布里埃尔。

books.title: FAMILY OF SPIES
books.author: Christine Kuehn
books.description: The story of a family that worked as Japanese and Nazi spies during World War II.
books.expected_description_zh: 讲述二战期间一个为日本和纳粹从事间谍活动的家庭的故事。

books.title: BAD BLOOD
books.author: John Carreyrou
books.description: The rise and fall of Theranos, the biotech startup that failed to deliver on its promise to make blood testing more efficient.
books.expected_description_zh: 讲述生物科技初创公司 Theranos 的兴衰；该公司未能兑现提高血液检测效率的承诺。

books.title: MOTHER MARY COMES TO ME
books.author: Arundhati Roy
books.description: The author of “The Ministry of Utmost Happiness” ruminates on her relationship with her late mother.
books.expected_description_zh: 《极乐之邦》（The Ministry of Utmost Happiness）的作者回顾自己与已故母亲的关系。

books.title: FRIENDS, LOVERS, AND THE BIG TERRIBLE THING
books.author: Matthew Perry
books.description: The late actor, known for playing Chandler Bing on “Friends,” shares stories from his childhood and his struggles with sobriety.
books.expected_title_zh: 朋友、爱人和那件可怕的大事
books.expected_description_zh: 因在《老友记》中饰演钱德勒·宾而闻名的已故演员，讲述童年经历及为保持清醒而奋斗的故事。

books.title: BIG DUMB EYES
books.author: Nate Bargatze
books.description: The Grammy Award-winning comedian shares snippets from his life and career.
books.expected_description_zh: 格莱美奖得主、喜剧演员分享自己生活和职业经历中的片段。

books.title: THIS IS A DOOR
books.author: Daniel Nayeri
books.description: A boy named Nothing the Younger and his friends accompany the Wander Prince on an adventure to defeat the Giantess. (Ages 8 to 12)
books.expected_description_zh: 名叫“小无名”（Nothing the Younger）的男孩和朋友们陪伴流浪王子踏上冒险，打败女巨人。（适读年龄：8至12岁）

books.title: HOW TO CATCH A TURKEY
books.author: Adam Wallace
books.description: Students try to catch a runaway turkey before their Thanksgiving play. (Ages 4 to 8)
books.expected_description_zh: 感恩节演出前，学生们试图抓住一只逃跑的火鸡。（适读年龄：4至8岁）

books.title: WILDWOOD CHRONICLES
books.author: Colin Meloy
books.description: Prue McKeel and Curtis Mehlberg’s adventures in the Impassable Wilderness. The basis for the movie "Wildwood." (Ages 8 and up)
books.expected_description_zh: 普鲁·麦基尔和柯蒂斯·梅尔伯格在不可通行荒野中的冒险；本书是电影《Wildwood》的原作。（适读年龄：8岁及以上）

books.title: DUNGEON CRAWLER CARL, VOL. 2
books.author: Tevagah
books.description: Difficult characters might make it tricky for Carl and Princess Donut to get to the second floor.
books.expected_description_zh: 棘手的人物可能会让卡尔和甜甜圈公主难以抵达第二层。

books.title: CHAINSAW MAN, VOL. 22
books.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
books.description: Denji and Yoru take a breather as the truth about Fami being the Death Devil becomes known.
books.expected_description_zh: 当法米（Fami）是死亡恶魔的真相逐渐为人所知时，电次和夜（Yoru）得以喘口气。

books.title: BABY-SITTERS LITTLE SISTER: KAREN’S NEW YEAR
books.author: Ann M. Martin
books.description: Karen seems to be the only one keeping her New Year’s promises.
books.expected_title_zh: 保姆俱乐部的小妹妹：凯伦的新年
books.expected_description_zh: 凯伦似乎是唯一一个坚持履行新年承诺的人。

books.title: LORE OLYMPUS, VOL. 11
books.author: Rachel Smythe
books.description: In this final volume, Hades and Persephone fight to get back together and prevent Apollo from destroying the realms.
books.expected_description_zh: 在最终卷中，哈迪斯与珀耳塞福涅为重新团聚并阻止阿波罗毁灭各个领域而战斗。

books.title: THE SUMMER HIKARU DIED, VOL. 8
books.author: Mokumokuren
books.description: “Hikaru" returns and presents a threat that forces Kurebayashi to make a tough decision; translated by Ajani Oloye.
books.expected_description_zh: “光”归来，带来的威胁迫使暮林做出艰难决定；英文译者为阿贾尼·奥洛耶。

books.title: THE GUY SHE WAS INTERESTED IN WASN'T A GUY AT ALL, VOL. 4
books.author: Sumiko Arai
books.description: Mitsuki impulsively decides to go to the prom with Aya. Will there be something more between them after high school? Translated by Ajani Oloye.
books.expected_title_zh: 她感兴趣的人竟然不是男生：第4卷
books.expected_description_zh: 美月冲动地决定和阿雅一起参加毕业舞会。高中毕业后，她们之间会有进一步发展吗？英文译者为阿贾尼·奥洛耶。
